exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Quantifiers — much, many, little, few

items.prompt: We have ___ overdue invoices this month.
There is ___ cash left in the operating account.
items.hintAfterError: 'Cash' é incontável, e a ideia é de pouca quantidade.

items.prompt: Harry found ___ ways to free up working capital.
Only a ___ suppliers extended their terms.
There isn't ___ value trapped in inventory, but receivables are a problem.
items.hintAfterError: 'Value' é incontável: não use a forma dos contáveis.
